option.label: Enable save-load diagnostics
option.help: Writes one unit inventory log whenever a save is loaded.

option.label: Log directory
option.help: Absolute path, environment-variable path, root-relative path, or Default.

option.label: Pause seconds
option.help: Pauses after writing the unit inventory so an external memory scanner can attach.

option.label: Maximum retained files
option.help: Keeps the newest diagnostic logs and removes older ones.
